# Gate 4 — Genuine historical v4 continuation under physical facts

Status: prepared scope; implementation and runtime are not yet verified.
This is part of PR72 on `codex/gate4-authenticated-load-facts`. Root assigns one
writer after recording the receiving commit and accepting the final corpus.

## Objective and authority

Prove that genuine pre-mass saved campaigns preserve original history, player
authority and pending work under the new application; complete that work, enable
physical facts through the real Host offer, and continue Ground and Inspiration
play with version5 commands. This closes the historical dependency in the
[physical-facts plan](gate4-authenticated-load-facts.md). It advances the product
contract's exact recovery, conservative facts, player agency, private information
and local/offline tactical play. Root AGENTS, the product definition, Gate4,
ADRs009/011/012/020/024/025/027/028/029 and the physical-facts plan remain binding.

This does not implement carrying/capacity/support, repair the old Grapple display
label, replace native or human-play evidence, or close Gate4. The existing
current-build v4 case remains supplementary; it is not a historical producer.
No old case, source catalog, fixture or gameplay rule is weakened for these tests.

## Fixture loader and execution organization

Use one shared test-only loader and comparison support with three new integration
harnesses, one per route. Each route can be scheduled as a complete ordinary
Cargo harness; do not add large new cases to existing table_loop or Grapple
harnesses. Keep default test profiles, threading, toolchains and canonical
verification unchanged. No test is ignored or conditional on a capture variable.

Require schema/status/source/baseline/executable receipt identities, exact ordered
cut labels,8/7/7 cut counts, request versions and sequence increments. Verify all
declared byte lengths/SHA256 values and the complete expected file set. Reject
duplicates, duplicate authoritative JSON keys, case aliases, traversal, symlinks,
missing/extra files and mismatched cross-file command/binding/event joins. Keep
nested authoritative JSON as exact strings; do not deserialize/reserialize it as
a way to repair a historical export. Original request and response serialization
must reproduce the archived compact bytes before calling production APIs.

All positive campaigns come from actual `restore_campaign`, owned replay and
`submit_presented_table` on fresh file SQLite databases. No SQL/state patch may
manufacture a positive source, award, controller, effect, raw roll or candidate.
Read-only complete logical rows may establish atomicity. Ensure pools close and
temporary files are cleaned only within their specifically created paths.

## Required saved-cut matrix

Ground has eight original next inputs: G3-to-G4 activation, attack equipment
activation, real source-controller assignment, paid paired movement, selection
of the source opportunity, free release while its source raw is issued, the
source's actual physical miss, and EndTurn. Preserve the original paid first
step and unpaid interrupted step, both positions, exact hands/custody, Action
and Reaction spending, raw owner/purpose/work and source visibility. PC1's source
channel aliases its Player audience but does not grant PC1's character authority.

Each Inspiration route has seven next inputs: attack-equipment activation,
first award, excess award, actual owner's recipient/decline decision, original
physical1/replacement20 reroll, source-owned equipment finish, and EndTurn.
The genuine bridge between decision and reroll is retained with its actual
EndTurn/Goblin Grapple/save-choice commands. PC0 consumes once. Recipient PC1
retains its gift; decline PC1 remains uninvolved with none. Preserve the literal
old `Unsupported roll` reason in raw/presented DTOs and all roll-options results;
the current UI wording defect is a separate task.

Execute every cut without skipping, with route/cut diagnostics and explicit
completion evidence. For each before and expected-after image, restore, close
and reopen, compare production replay/state/export and every captured audience's
raw/presented DTO, revision, opaque handle and roll-options status/payload.
Only the export's `exported_at_utc` field may differ. Historical nested strings,
rows, IDs, timestamps, snapshots, sessions, causes and bindings remain literal.
On accepted endpoints, submit the original request as an exact retry before and
after cold reopen and independent portable restore. Response bytes and all rows
remain unchanged. Exercise all2/5/5 retained original bindings at their valid
endpoints, at route terminal, and after subsequent mass activation.

Separately restore each before image and accept its original next input once.
Require exact canonical state, typed TableEvent meta/action/nested outcome,
command identity and one new audit/event/projection/binding. Retry that new
acceptance exactly through cold and portable recovery. Every old row/string
remains unchanged; double charging, duplicated raw use or resource restoration
fails even if terminal positions look plausible.

Fresh acceptance legitimately allocates one new outer EventId, changed-audience
revisions and newly offered opaque handles. Relate only typed slots belonging
to that one new event and its exact audience/canonical capability. Old surviving
handles remain literal; actual changed-audience order and capability sequences
must match. Compare all other presentation fields and mechanics exactly.
Each branch's new digest must independently pass production authentication;
never rewrite it. An uninvolved audience retains literal presented bytes and
needs no mapping. No global UUID substitution or broad timestamp normalization.

## Genuine finish, activation and new version5 play

All old before/after cuts are Active. Current-revision Host mass activation must
refuse atomically there. Continue representative pending branches (Ground paid
opportunity and issued source raw, both Inspiration decisions and rerolls)
through the actual accepted old controls; issued work must drain before Finish.
Also continue all three terminal exports. ConcludeHostilities uses existing
cadence. Ground's spent Reaction requires the genuine next boundary that refreshes
it; premature Finish refuses. Use actual ownership/turn offers, not assigned state.
Inspiration terminals have no spent Reaction requiring that extra boundary.

Only the genuinely settled Finished campaign may accept Host M activation. Verify
request5/envelope6, independent G4/source2 capability meanings, old original
retries, fresh old4 refusal, read-only audiences and cold/portable/replay identity.
Admit a real settled physical fact through the current offered subject/source
where supported, without inventing a body weight or catalog receipt.

Ground's new encounter reuses the actual old characters/source/controller,
ordinary setup/initiative, new grip/save/equipment work, paid movement/opportunity,
release and source-owned physical answer under5. Preserve old history and current
private authority. Existing GroundDragV1 does not yet enforce pound capacity;
do not claim that the test implements carrying.

For recipient, PC1 initially still owns its historical gift. It is ineligible for
another gift until it genuinely spends that resource. Include PC1 and PC0 in the
new encounter; the actual source Goblin provokes PC1's owned save and PC1 reports
its physical Inspiration reroll, then finish the actual source equipment work.
Award PC0, issue excess, and transfer through PC0's actual offered recipient.
On a later genuine Goblin turn, PC0 performs its own new physical reroll. For
decline, PC1 starts without Inspiration; perform first/excess/decline and PC0's
new physical reroll without inventing a depletion step. Use real intervening
turns/actions. Both routes retain purpose/issuer/faces/payment and uncertain-ack
retry; cold/portable checks cover pending decision, raw, consumed and final work.

## Adversarial and atomic boundaries

Use explicitly labeled negative copies; never mutate the received files. Distinct
negative envelopes must be asserted different from a saved exact retry. Exercise
wrong owner/source/controller, foreign/stale handle, changed same-ID envelope,
premature M activation and fresh old version after activation; the intended
authority guard must be reached with otherwise current context. Correct original
retry or next input must still succeed afterward.

Validate loader packaging/cross-file failures separately from application restore
failures. Application negatives include removed creation/activation/controller/
award/reroll history; forged current plus matching latest snapshot; altered
projection audience/digest/revision/owner/visibility; altered Ground prefix/raw/
released grip; altered Inspiration owner/resource/faces; and mass/schema/version
smuggling without accepted activation. Post-M negatives use an actual newly
accepted positive branch. Assert the precise intended mutation and rejection
layer, not merely any error from an already-invalid fixture.

For rejected restore, use a database with a genuinely created unrelated sentinel;
compare complete ordered logical cells for all tables, no residual campaign rows,
and unchanged usable sentinel. Then restore the valid original to prove no lock
or partial import remains. Existing-campaign restore refuses without mutation.
For live refusal/read/retry, complete logical cells/export remain unchanged.
File/page hashes are not substitutes for logical transactional checks.
